newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thais to export 4.1 mln tns tapioca pellets in '98.
newsitem.headline: Thais to export 4.1 mln tns tapioca pellets in '98.

text.p: Thailand's 1998 tapioca pellet exports are forecast to reach 4.1 million tonnes, slightly higher than that projected for 1997, a commerce ministry official said on Friday.
Of the total, about 3.6 tonnes will go to the EU and the rest to non-EU markets, the official said.
The 1997/98 output of cassava, which is used to make tapioca products such as pellets, starch and chips, was projected at 18.54 tonnes, she said.
But the commerce ministry expressed concerns about local prices, which could be pressured by surplus as carry-over stocks of pellets is expected to at 1.2 million tonnes.
"Based on this projection, we believe that the cassava roots surplus could reach 2.4 million tonnes and that would make it difficult for farmers to sell at good prices," the official said.
But the ministry has set up a working group to find support measures for 1997/98 crop year, she said.
